question: may every unit be taken off its transport before the Place Units Phase, and which other choices are never better than another on the same menu
policy: tools/check_zone_names.py random policy (uniform moves; where the phase can end, end it with probability 0.02, 0.05 or 0.10 by seed % 3), eleven rounds

counting.identical_units: unit ids in an option's parameters replaced by the unit's full state (all fields but id; cargo by type); options that then coincide counted once, as in tools/decision_census.py symmetry
counting.rail: movement_route in mode strategic_rail or strategic_river whose unit has a noncombat ordinary movement_route to the same last zone in the same menu
counting.recruitment: menus offering recruitment_roll; skipped when the policy chose end_phase in such a menu

rules.RB 11.4.1: naval cargo is unloaded into adjacent land zones; an ally's unit loads on its own turn, rides on yours, unloads on its next
rules.RB 11.5: a naval transport may go in port with or without cargo; unloading is decided as it berths; unloaded cargo cannot move for the rest of the Calendar Turn
rules.RB 11.3.1: an air transport picks its cargo up before or during its noncombat move and unloads it in a Friendly-possessed land zone; an ally's unit loads on its own turn and unloads on its next
rules.RB 10.6.5: carpet bombing attacks only land units
rules.RB 12.7: controlled minor powers make recruitment rolls; success gives 1 infantry or 2 militia, a ship advance or a facility repair
rules.RB 8.2.1: Improved Construction: -1 IPP per stage for facilities, facility upgrades and naval units, or the first two stages condensed into one

engine.air cargo on landing: src/air.cpp air_land_noncombat steps off only militia
engine.rail move: src/movement.cpp: strategic rail adds to the region's rail counter, marks strategic_moved and ends movement; ordinary moves subtract their cost
engine.price options: src/catalog.cpp priceOptions: printed, plus improved_construction_discount and improved_construction_combine for naval units and facilities with Improved Construction
engine.recruitment: src/politics_influence.cpp: recruitment_roll is offered beside the other Place Units moves; a failed roll only marks recruitment_attempted
engine.aircraft given up: src/air.cpp mayBeGivenUp: only when some aircraft must be lost or this one has no landing spot

decision.quote: I mean if there are cases where not unloading is better we then should keep the option of having them loaded, lets just make it not allowed to upgrade a loaded unit to something not carry-able then . And for the ones you found that was never worse off and equivalent, just disallow the options that do things in a more expensive way
kept: moves for another of several identical units
decision.ruled: RCL-021: an upgrade may not leave a transport carrying a unit it may not carry
left_out: strategic rail move to a zone the same unit reaches by an ordinary move
printed price where Improved Construction offers the discount
decision.open: whether to bar upgrades of units aboard ships at sea (RB 12.3)

mutations_caught.air cargo accepts any land unit: Upgrade offered that would leave an air transport carrying motorized infantry
mutations_caught.naval cargo ignores the one-unit limit: Upgrade offered that would leave a naval transport two units that are not infantry-class
